rule.query: SELECT evidence_id, source_file, timestamp, channel, event_id, computer, target_user, subject_user, src_ip, process_name, command_line, service_name, 'DNS Query Request By Regsvr32.EXE' AS sigma_title, 'Detects DNS queries initiated by "Regsvr32.exe"' AS sigma_description, 'Dmitriy Lifanov, oscd.community' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational') AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon') AND event_id IN (22) AND (COALESCE(CAST(channel AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' ESCAPE '\', FALSE) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 22, FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE)) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id
rule.title: DNS Query Request By Regsvr32.EXE

SELECT evidence_id, source_file, timestamp, channel, event_id, computer, target_user, subject_user, src_ip, process_name, command_line, service_name, 'Python Image Load By Non-Python Process' AS sigma_title, 'Detects the image load of "Python Core" by a non-Python process. This might be indicative of a execution of executable that has been bundled from Python code.
Various tools like Py2Exe, PyInstaller, and cx_Freeze are used to bundle Python code into standalone executables.
Threat actors often use these tools to bundle malicious Python scripts into executables, sometimes to obfuscate the code or to bypass security measures.
' AS sigma_description, 'Patrick St. John, OTR (Open Threat Research)' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational') AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon') AND event_id IN (7) AND (COALESCE(CAST(channel AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' ESCAPE '\', FALSE) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 7, FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Description"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Description"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Description"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Description"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Python Core' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND NOT (COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%Python%' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) OR list_contains(list_transform(['C:\\Program Files\\%', 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\%', 'C:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\%'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE)) AND NOT CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END IS NULL) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id

SELECT evidence_id, source_file, timestamp, channel, event_id, computer, target_user, subject_user, src_ip, process_name, command_line, service_name, 'Winlogon Helper DLL' AS sigma_title, 'Winlogon.exe is a Windows component responsible for actions at logon/logoff as well as the secure attention sequence (SAS) triggered by Ctrl-Alt-Delete.
Registry entries in HKLM\Software[Wow6432Node]Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\ and HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\ are
used to manage additional helper programs and functionalities that support Winlogon. Malicious modifications to these Registry keys may cause Winlogon to
load and execute malicious DLLs and/or executables.
' AS sigma_description, 'Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE ((channel = 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') = 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell') OR (channel = 'PowerShellCore/Operational' AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') = 'PowerShellCore')) AND event_id IN (4104) AND ((list_contains(list_transform(['Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational', 'PowerShellCore/Operational'], sigma_pattern -> COALESCE(CAST(channel AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 4104, FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Winlogon%' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%Set-ItemProperty%', '%New-Item%'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ScriptBlockText"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE))) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id

</ProcessAccess>

Example sysmon config snippet with grouping, as logging individual ProcessAccess events can generate excessive logs:
<ProcessAccess onmatch="include">
    <Rule groupRelation="and">
    <TargetImage condition="end with">\MsMpEng.exe</TargetImage>
    <SourceImage condition="end with">\WerFaultSecure.exe</SourceImage>
    </Rule>
</ProcessAccess>

ESCAPE '\', FALSE) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 1, FALSE) AND (COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%\\AccCheckConsole.exe' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) OR COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'AccCheckConsole.exe' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE)) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['% -hwnd%', '% -process %', '% -window %'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' '$.winlog.event_data."ParentProcessName"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%\\ArcSOC.exe' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%\\cmd.exe', '%\\cscript.exe', '%\\mshta.exe', '%\\powershell.exe', '%\\pwsh.exe', '%\\regsvr32.exe', '%\\rundll32.exe', '%\\wmic.exe', '%\\wscript.exe'], sigma_pattern '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN rule.query:
SELECT evidence_id, source_file, timestamp, channel, event_id, computer, target_user, subject_user, src_ip, process_name, command_line, service_name, 'Windows Credential Guard Registry Tampering Via CommandLine' AS sigma_title, 'Detects attempts to add, modify, or delete Windows Credential Guard related registry keys or values via command line tools such as Reg.exe or PowerShell.
Credential Guard uses virtualization-based security to isolate secrets so that only privileged system software can access them.
Adversaries may disable Credential Guard to gain access to sensitive credentials stored in the system, such as NTLM hashes and Kerberos tickets, which can be used for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
The rule matches suspicious command lines that target DeviceGuard or LSA registry paths and manipulate keys like EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity, RequirePlatformSecurityFeatures, or LsaCfgFlags.
Such activity may indicate an attempt to disable or tamper with Credential Guard, potentially exposing sensitive credentials for misuse.
' AS sigma_description, 'Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational') AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon') AND event_id IN (1) AND (COALESCE(CAST(channel AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' ESCAPE '\', FALSE) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 1, FALSE) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%\\powershell.exe', '%\\pwsh.exe', '%\\reg.exe'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE) OR list_contains(list_transform(['PowerShell.EXE', 'pwsh.dll', 'reg.exe'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE)) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%add %', '%New-ItemProperty %', '%Set-ItemProperty %', '%si %', '%delete %', '%del %', '%Remove-ItemProperty %', '%rp %'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE)) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%\\Control\\DeviceGuard%', '%\\Control\\LSA%', '%Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\DeviceGuard%'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE)) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity%', '%RequirePlatformSecurityFeatures%', '%LsaCfgFlags%'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE))) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id

rule.query: SELECT evidence_id, source_file, timestamp, channel, event_id, computer, target_user, subject_user, src_ip, process_name, command_line, service_name, 'HackTool - CoercedPotato Execution' AS sigma_title, 'Detects the use of CoercedPotato, a tool for privilege escalation' AS sigma_description, 'Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational') AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon') AND event_id IN (1) AND (COALESCE(CAST(channel AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' ESCAPE '\', FALSE) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 1, FALSE) AND (COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%\\CoercedPotato.exe' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) OR COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '% --exploitId %' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) OR list_contains(list_transform(['%IMPHASH=A75D7669DB6B2E107A44C4057FF7F7D6%', '%IMPHASH=F91624350E2C678C5DCBE5E1F24E22C9%', '%IMPHASH=14C81850A079A87E83D50CA41C709A15%'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Hashes"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Hashes"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Hashes"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Hashes"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE))) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id

or checking for the presence of such records through the `nslookup` command.

AS sigma_description, 'frack113' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational') AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon') AND event_id IN (1) AND (COALESCE(CAST(channel AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' ESCAPE '\', FALSE) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 1, FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%\\PrintBrm.exe' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '% -f%' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE)) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id
rule.title: PrintBrm ZIP Creation of Extraction

list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, rule.query:
SELECT evidence_id, source_file, timestamp, channel, event_id, computer, target_user, subject_user, src_ip, process_name, command_line, service_name, 'ETW Logging Tamper In .NET Processes Via CommandLine' AS sigma_title, 'Detects changes to environment variables related to ETW logging via the CommandLine.
This could indicate potential adversaries stopping ETW providers recording loaded .NET assemblies.
' AS sigma_description, 'Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Security') AND ((json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing') AND event_id IN (4688))) AND event_id IN (4688) AND (COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 4688, FALSE) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%COMPlus\_ETWEnabled%', '%COMPlus\_ETWFlags%'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE))) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id

'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational') AND json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon') AND event_id IN (1) AND (COALESCE(CAST(channel AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' ESCAPE '\', FALSE) AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 1, FALSE) AND (list_contains(list_transform(['%\\calc.exe', '%\\certutil.exe', '%\\cmstp.exe', '%\\cscript.exe', '%\\installutil.exe', '%\\mshta.exe', '%\\regsvr32.exe', '%\\rundll32.exe', '%\\wscript.exe'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."Image"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE) OR list_contains(list_transform(['CALC.EXE', 'CertUtil.exe', 'CMSTP.EXE', 'cscript.exe', 'installutil.exe', 'MSHTA.EXE', 'REGSVR32.EXE', 'RUNDLL32.EXE', 'wscript.exe'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OriginalFileName"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE)) AND NOT (COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%C:\\%' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) OR COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) OR CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CurrentDirectory"[*]') ELSE NULL END IS NULL)) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id

'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%nanodump%' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."CommandLine"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE))) ORDER BY timestamp NULLS LAST, evidence_id

and will execute registered JScript or VBScript code as a result.
Script event consumers are a built-in Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) class that
automatically executes a predefined script (in VBScript or JScript) whenever a specific system event occurs.
Adversaries often abuse script event consumers to maintain persistence on a compromised host
by executing a malicious script whenever a specific event occurs.

The DSRM account is an “Administrator” account that logs in with the DSRM mode when the server is booting up to restore AD backups or recover the server from a failure.
Attackers could abuse DSRM account to maintain their persistence and access to the organization''s Active Directory.

If the "DsrmAdminLogonBehavior" value is set to "2", the administrator account can always be used.

rule.query:
SELECT evidence_id, source_file, timestamp, channel, event_id, computer, target_user, subject_user, src_ip, process_name, command_line, service_name, 'RDP Sensitive Settings Changed' AS sigma_title, 'Detects tampering of RDP Terminal Service/Server sensitive settings.
Such as allowing unauthorized users access to a system via the ''fAllowUnsolicited'' or enabling RDP via ''fDenyTSConnections'', etc.

Below is a list of registry keys/values that are monitored by this rule:

- Shadow: Used to enable Remote Desktop shadowing, which allows an administrator to view or control a user''s session.
- DisableRemoteDesktopAntiAlias: Disables anti-aliasing for remote desktop sessions.
- DisableSecuritySettings: Disables certain security settings for Remote Desktop connections.
- fAllowUnsolicited: Allows unsolicited remote assistance offers.
- fAllowUnsolicitedFullControl: Allows unsolicited remote assistance offers with full control.
- InitialProgram: Specifies a program to run automatically when a user logs on to a remote computer.
- ServiceDll: Used in RDP hijacking techniques to specify a custom DLL to be loaded by the Terminal Services service.
- SecurityLayer: Specifies the security layer used for RDP connections.
' AS sigma_description, 'Samir Bousseaden, David ANDRE, Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g, Nasreddine Bencherchali' AS sigma_author, 'https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma' AS sigma_source FROM evtx_events WHERE channel IN ('Security') AND ((json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.provider.name') IN ('Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing') AND event_id IN (4657))) AND event_id IN (4657) AND (COALESCE(TRY_CAST(event_id AS BIGINT) = 4657, FALSE) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OperationType"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OperationType"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OperationType"') = 'ARRAY' THEN json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."OperationType"[*]') ELSE NULL END, sigma_item -> COALESCE(CAST(sigma_item AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'Existing registry value modified' ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE), FALSE) AND ((list_contains(list_transform(['%\\Control\\Terminal Server\\%', '%\\Windows NT\\Terminal Services\\%'], sigma_pattern -> list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ObjectName"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT', 'DOUBLE', 'BOOLEAN') THEN [json_extract_string(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ObjectName"')] WHEN json_type(raw_json, sigma_pattern ESCAPE '\', FALSE)), TRUE)), TRUE)) AND COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(CASE WHEN json_type(raw_json, '$.winlog.event_data."ObjectName"') IN ('VARCHAR', 'BIGINT', 'UBIGINT',
